data.one_liner: A Dart client for Google Cloud Storage.
data.what_it_does: Allows interacting with Google Cloud Storage to manage buckets and upload, download, or modify objects. Uses Application Default Credentials for authentication.
use_when: You need to access Google Cloud Storage from a Dart or Flutter application.
You want to programmatically create buckets, upload files, and manage object metadata.
avoid_when: You need local device storage rather than a cloud-hosted storage service.
You want a stable package since this one is currently experimental and subject to breaking changes.
strengths: Official Google Cloud client support for buckets and objects.
Built-in automatic retry handling for idempotent operations.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Currently experimental and published under labs.dart.dev with a high expected rate of API and breaking changes.
Requires proper cloud authentication setup outside of Google Cloud.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up authentication (Application Default Credentials) when used outside of Google Cloud.
